draft.subject: Following up on your cancellation question
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks again for raising the cancellation timing question — to confirm what I sent yesterday, a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately. Your ticket is still open on our side, so nothing is lost while you decide.

If it's useful before then, I'd be glad to help you set up one real project — projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. Just reply with the work you'd want to track and I'll walk you through it, or we can do a short call this week.
